title: Learned Bow Control on a Measured Bowed-String Model: a Revised Minimum-Bow-Force Law, a Recurrent Controller, and the Domain of a Supervision Ceiling
abstract: arXiv:2609.14990v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A finite-difference bowed-string model with implicitly resolved Stribeck friction is presented, with a regime diagnostic, the Schelleng bow-force limits on four strings, and a comparison of learned bow controllers. Implicit resolution is necessary, and quantitatively so: a lagged contact force cannot capture the string on a discrete grid, so no stick phase forms at any bow force. With friction, impedance and quality factor taken from published measurement rather than fitted, all four strings return a stick fraction of 89.1% against an ideal 90%. Schelleng's maximum bow force is recovered on every string. The minimum is not: it follows $Z v_b \beta^{-1}$ rather than the predicted $Z^2 v_b \beta^{-2}$, reducing both squared dependences to first powers. translated_title: 基于实测弓弦模型的习得弓控制：修正的最小弓力定律、循环控制器与监督上限的适用范围
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种具有隐式求解Stribeck摩擦的有限差分弓弦模型，包含振动状态诊断、四根弦上的Schelleng弓力限制，以及对学习型弓控制器的比较。隐式求解在定量上是必要的：滞后的接触力无法在离散网格上捕捉琴弦运动，因此在任何弓力下都不会形成粘着阶段。当摩擦系数、阻抗和品质因子取自已发表的测量数据而非拟合所得时，所有四根弦的粘着比例达到89.1%，接近90%的理想值。Schelleng的最大弓力在每根弦上均得到复现，但最小弓力并非如此：实际结果遵循 $Z v_b \beta^{-1}$ 而非预测的 $Z^2 v_b \beta^{-2}$，将两个平方依赖关系均降为一次幂。六个容量匹配的控制器在四根弦上各进行二十次随机种子实验，结果表明门控循环网络在大多数情况下优于前馈网络，尤其是在弓行程中段受到扰动时。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于实测参数、隐式求解摩擦的弓弦模型，修正了Schelleng最小弓力定律（将平方依赖降为一次幂依赖），并证明门控循环网络弓控制器在扰动条件下优于前馈网络。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a measured-parameter bowed-string model with implicitly resolved friction, revises Schelleng's minimum bow-force law by reducing squared dependences to first powers, and shows that a gated recurrent network controller outperforms a feedforward one under mid-stroke disturbances.
